verses.text: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over the lake and came to his own town.
Some people brought to him a man who could not move, lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man, "Cheer up, son! Your sins are forgiven."
Some of the teachers of the law said to themselves, "This man is insulting God!"
Jesus knew what they were thinking. So he said, "Why are you thinking evil things in your hearts?
Which is easier to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or 'Get up and walk'?
But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins." Then he said to the man who could not move, "Get up, pick up your mat and go home."
And the man got up and went home.
When the crowd saw this, they were filled with wonder. They praised God for giving such authority to human beings.
As Jesus went on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax collector's booth. "Follow me," he told him. And Matthew got up and followed him.
Later Jesus was having a meal at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Jesus and his followers.
When the Pharisees saw this, they asked his followers, "Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
Jesus heard this and said, "Healthy people do not need a doctor. Sick people do.
Go and learn what this means: 'I want mercy, not sacrifice.' I have not come to call good people, but sinners, to turn away from their sins."
Then John's followers came and asked Jesus, "We and the Pharisees often go without food. Why do your followers not fast?"
Jesus answered, "How can the guests of the bridegroom be sad while he is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast.
"No one sews a patch of new cloth on old clothes. The new patch will shrink and pull away from the clothes, and the tear will get worse.

And people do not pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst. The wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are kept safe."
While Jesus was saying this, a synagogue leader came and knelt in front of him. He said, "My daughter has just died. But come and put your hand on her, and she will live."
Jesus got up and went with him, and so did his followers.
Just then a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus. She touched the edge of his clothes.
She said to herself, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed."
Jesus turned and saw her. "Cheer up, daughter," he said. "Your faith has healed you." And the woman was healed from that moment.
When Jesus arrived at the leader's house, he saw people playing flutes and a noisy crowd.
He said, "Go away. The girl is not dead. She is asleep." But they laughed at him.
After the crowd had been sent outside, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.
News about this spread all over that area.
As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed him. They shouted, "Have mercy on us, Son of David!"
When he went indoors, the blind men came to him. Jesus asked them, "Do you believe that I can do this?" "Yes, Lord," they replied.
Then he touched their eyes and said, "Because of your faith, it will happen to you."
And they could see again. Jesus warned them strongly, "Make sure that no one knows about this."
But they went out and spread the news about him all over that area.
While they were going out, some people brought to Jesus a man who could not talk because he had a demon.
When the demon was driven out, the man began to speak. The crowd was amazed and said, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!"
But the Pharisees said, "It is by the ruler of demons that he drives out demons."
Jesus went through all the towns and villages. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about the kingdom. And he healed every kind of disease and illness.
When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them, because they were worried and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
Then he said to his followers, "The harvest is huge, but there are only a few workers.
So ask the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into his harvest field."
